    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    output reg [4:0] wave
);

    reg state;
 

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin 
        if (!rst_n) begin 
            state <= 0;
            wave <= 0;
        end 
        else begin 
            case (state)
                0: begin 
                    if (wave == 31) begin 
                        state <= 1;
                    end 
                    else begin 
                        wave <= wave + 1;
                    end 
                end 
                1: begin 
                    if (wave == 0) begin 
                        state <= 0;
                    end 
                    else begin 
                        wave <= wave - 1;
                    end 
                end 
            endcase 
        end 
    end 

endmodule

    input RST,
    output reg [5:0] Hours,
    output reg [5:0] Mins,
    output reg [5:0] Secs
);

    if (RST) begin
        Secs <= 6'd0;
    end
    else begin
        if (Secs == 6'd59) begin
            Secs <= 6'd0;
        end
        else begin
            Secs <= Secs + 6'd1;
        end
    end
end

    if (RST) begin
        Mins <= 6'd0;
    end
    else begin
        if ((Mins == 6'd59) && (Secs == 6'd59)) begin
            Mins <= 6'd0;
        end
        else if (Secs == 6'd59) begin
            Mins <= Mins + 6'd1;
        end
        else begin
            Mins <= Mins;
        end
    end
end


always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
    if (RST) begin
        Hours <= 6'd0;
    end
    else begin
        if ((Hours == 6'd23) && (Mins == 6'd59) && (Secs == 6'd59)) begin
            Hours <= 6'd0;
        end
        else if ((Mins == 6'd59) && (Secs == 6'd59)) begin
            Hours <= Hours + 6'd1;
        end
        else begin
            Hours <= Hours;
        end
    end
end
